{{Term/Store|Cow|Cows|Series, MM, MM3D|plural}} are a recurring species in {{TLoZ Series}}.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote= |book= E |publisher= |page= 62 {{Exp Game|Series}}}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|How many {{Color MM3D|Red|cows}} are there at {{Color MM3D|Red|Romani Ranch}}?|Keaton|MM3D}}</ref> Cows go unnamed in {{EoW}}. They are [[Hyrule]]'s primary source of [[Milk]], and are kept in the land's various farms. A few Cows seem to strangely possess the ability to talk, such as speaking to [[Link]].

==Characteristics==
==={{OoT|-}}===
In {{OoT}}, Cows can be found all over Hyrule. Many can be found in various holes and caverns, but a few are also kept at [[Lon Lon Ranch]], and tended to by [[Talon]] and [[Malon]]. In this game, a free Bottle of Milk can be obtained by playing "[[Epona's Song]]" in front of a Cow. They will appreciate the song, and give Link milk for it.<ref>{{Cite|Moooooooooo! What a nice song... It reminds me of the pasture... That song makes me feel so good, I can produce a lot of milk! Have some of my refreshing and nutritious milk!|Cow|OoT}}</ref> In the {{MQ}} version, several Cows can be found  [[Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly]]. These Cows serve a rather odd function of being a switch, unlocking doors and dropping Treasure Chests or items when hit by the [[Slingshot]].

Link can win his own Cow by beating the Obstacle Course record at Lon Lon Ranch. The Cow will be delivered to [[Link's House|his house]] and can be found in his room.

==={{MM|-}}===
Cows are also featured in {{MM}}. They are not as commonly found around [[Termina]] as they are in Hyrule, but there are several special "Romani-Bred" Cows at [[Romani Ranch]], from which one can milk [[Chateau Romani]].<ref>{{Cite|The special Romani-bred cows are the source of Chateau Romani, the most desired of forbidden milk! It is a mystical milk that fills you with Magic Power...|Cremia|MM}}</ref> As in {{OoT|-}}, "Epona's Song" can be played to a Cow, and they will produce regular Milk to give to Link for free.<ref>{{Cite|Moo! Nice moooosic. It reminds me of the pasture. That song just makes me want to let go and put out a lot of milk! I'll give some to you. Milk will make you very healthy.|Cow|MM}}</ref> The [[Ghost (Majora's Mask)|Ghost]]s come on the first day to abduct the Cows from the Ranch, and Link is hired by [[Romani]] to fend them off.<ref>{{Cite|My older sister won't believe me... But Romani must protect the cows! Hey, Grasshopper, I'm recruiting for an assistant right now! You're a boy, won't you try?|Romani|MM}}</ref> If Link fails, the Cows are taken, and the girl with them.

Cow figurines are also found on the counters of many shops in [[Clock Town]], and they are the subject of one of [[Keaton]]'s questions.<ref>{{Cite|Answer me this... Pick one of the three choices... How many tiny cow figurines are there in Clock Town?|Keaton|MM}}</ref>

==={{TMC|-}}===
Cows also appear in {{TMC}}, although they appear slightly differently than their past incarnations. The majority of these Cows appear in [[Lon Lon Ranch]] under the care of [[Talon]] and [[Malon]], where they produce [[Lon Lon Milk]] that Malon brings to [[Hyrule Town]], via [[Epona]] and cart, to be sold. Cows also serve as occasional road blocks and will only move once [[Link]] has progressed further on his quest.

[[Elsie]], one of the Cows at [[Lon Lon Ranch]], can [[Kinstone Fusion|Fuse]] [[Kinstone]]s with Link if he is [[Minish]]-sized. A Cow also appears in the "At Lon Lon Ranch" [[Figurine]].

==={{BotW|-}} and {{TotK|-}}===
{{Main|Hateno Cow}}
Domestic variants of [[Water Buffalo]]s, known as [[Hateno Cow]]s, appear in {{BotW}} and {{TotK}}. They can be found grazing in [[Hateno Pasture]].

==={{EoW|-}}===
Three Cows reside at [[Hyrule Ranch]]. Two can be found outdoors, while the third is inside the Ranch's main building. During the [[Credits]], several residents of Hyrule Ranch can be seen together, including one of the Cows.

==Other Appearances==
==={{OoA|-}} (Himekawa)===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
In the {{OoA (Himekawa)}}, Link wins 200 Rupees and a Cow after winning an arena match.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote= THE WINNER IS...'''''LINK!''''' HIS PRIZE...200 RUPEES AND ONE COW!|book= {{OoA (Himekawa)|-}}|publisher= VIZ Media|page= 8}}</ref> [[Impa]] angrily raises the Cow over her head after scolding Link for entering the match.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote= AND WHAT'RE YOU GOING TO '''''DO''''' WITH A '''''COW'''''?|book= {{OoA (Himekawa)|-}}|publisher= VIZ Media|page= 11}}</ref> Her mood changes when Link reveals to have won the Cow for his grandmother, who needs another one.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote= I THOUGHT I'D SEND IT TO THE FARM. GRANDMA COULD REALLY USE ANOTHER COW.|book= {{OoA (Himekawa)|-}}|publisher= VIZ Media|page= 11}}</ref> 

The Cow makes a final appearance when Link returns to his grandparents' farm. 
{{Noncanon|End}}
